title: Light Use
text: Light Use. I would recommend this burner for infrequent light use only. It is not the best quality at all. It does heat up fast and hot. When I put an empty pot on it to test what it would hold, it started popping and creaking and pinging like crazy. Nothing in the pot, just a heavy duty stainless pan. Would probably be fine for a college dorm room or camping. I'm hoping it will work for me just as a warming burner during entertaining. Very short cord for safety and needs to be out at least 4 inches from the wall.  Worked OK on my island, but on a regular counter I'm not sure I would be too thrilled.
